Applies on the Inntal A12 motorway and the Brenner A13 motorway if the destination is in Italy or in a country that is reached via Italy
Public holiday: Day of the Republic of Italy

The restriction applies to the section of the A12 Inntal, A13 Brenner oraz A14 Rheintal/Walgau motorway between the Nößlach exit and Brenner Nord-towards the Austrian‑Italian border, if the purpose of the journey requires travel along this section.
only in: Baden-Württemberg, Bayern, Hessen, Nordrhein-Westfalen and Rhineland-Palatinate and Saar
